description: Rename a page and/or change its URL slug — the Pages panel's rename. Links that pointed at the old `./slug.html` on every page follow the new slug. The home page's `index` slug is locked (its display name can still change).

fileName.description: New URL slug without .html (e.g. 'pricing', or 'blog/launch' for a page in a folder). Sanitized and de-duplicated against other pages.

page.description: Page id, name or current slug (from `list_pages`).

name: swebsy_update_page
title: Update page
